summary: Iteration 7 — Notification email preferences + event notifications (backend REST only, per review-request scope). Created /app/backend/tests/test_notification_prefs.py (11 tests, 5 classes) → 11/11 PASSED in 18.87s (pytest -n 0). Coverage: (1) GET /api/notifications/preferences returns exactly the 5 required keys (email_invites, email_matches, email_prize, email_wallet, email_disputes), all defaulting to true for a fresh user; (2) PATCH single-key persists via GET round-trip and leaves other 4 keys untouched; (3) PATCH multi-key (email_invites=true + email_wallet=false) updates both correctly; (4) PATCH true→false→true flip works; (5) PATCH with empty body is idempotent (returns defaults); (6) unauthenticated GET → 401/403; (7) full E2E — userA invites userB (challenge_invite in-app row for userB) → userB accepts (match_starting in-app row for userA) → both report DIFFERENT winners (challenge.status='disputed', BOTH players get support_update in-app rows); (8) OPT-OUT INVARIANT — userC PATCHes email_invites=false, userA invites userC, and the in-app challenge_invite row is STILL inserted for userC (email skip at server.py:1327-1329 does NOT block the in-app insert at server.py:1315-1319); (9) decline creates challenge_declined for creator; (10) creator-cancel creates challenge_invite_cancelled for opponent; (11) both-agree auto-settle → prize_payout in-app row for the winner. Backend logs during the run only contain handled 'Email send failed: 429 rate_limited' entries (Resend upstream rate limit — expected because Emergent Resend blocks unverified recipients / throttles bursts); send_email() wraps httpx in try/except at server.py:110-113, so no uncaught tracebacks surface to callers. Wallet funding was done via direct Mongo patch (LIVE Stripe key active — do NOT use real deposits). Tournament prize_payout, tournament dispute, deposit polling and withdrawal-settled event emails were NOT re-tested in this iteration (previous iterations covered the underlying flows; the notification wiring is identical to the H2H paths which passed here, and Resend rate-limit blocked bursts of new deposits anyway).

minor.issue: Resend is currently returning 429 rate_limited for the shared Emergent test key on almost every send during heavy test runs. This is handled non-fatally (try/except at server.py:110-113 logs and swallows), so in-app notifications, API responses and business logic are all unaffected. Real user deliverability from this preview backend may still be intermittent — main agent may want to add either a token-bucket in send_email or upgrade the Emergent Resend quota before production.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: rate-limit / backoff in send_email() (server.py:98-113) to avoid the Resend 429 storm visible in backend.err.log during load — currently it just logs each 429 as ERROR. Otherwise nothing to fix for iter 7.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1301-1337 _notify() correctly always inserts the in-app row BEFORE evaluating email prefs, so pref gates can never suppress the DB row (verified by TestOptOutStillInsertsInApp).
server.py:1315-1319 notifications.insert_one payload includes id/user_id/kind/message/category/ref_id/read/created_at — matches the shape queried by GET /notifications and the frontend list. Good.

server.py:1355-1377 NotifPrefsIn is a strict Optional[bool] schema — PATCH silently drops keys not in the whitelist, which is the intended fail-safe. Empty body returns DEFAULT_EMAIL_PREFS instead of 400 (arguable but harmless).

server.py:160-170 NOTIF_EMAIL_PREF_MAP maps 'match_results' to 'email_matches' — but the loser's match_results _notify call (line 985) is invoked WITHOUT email_subject, so the pref gate is never reached (early return at 1320-1321). Consistent with 'winner gets prize_payout email, loser only in-app'.
server.py:110-113 send_email swallows every failure in a try/except — this is the reason the Resend 429/422 errors do not break the test run. Confirmed non-fatal.

server.py:902-935 dispute path calls _notify for BOTH creator and opponent with the same email_subject/body/cta — confirmed both receive an in-app support_update row (TestEventNotificationsInsertedInApp).
server.py:971-984 winner prize_payout _notify includes email_subject + email_body + CTA to /wallet — winner in-app row confirmed by TestPrizePayoutOnAgreement.
